name: Venomed Claw
description: One arm, held up, with the hook wet and three drops coming off it — the biggest still hanging under the claw, the next mid-fall, the last already small. The find puts poison on the hand's bite, so what is drawn is the claw *loaded* rather than the claw closing: a single limb on the diagonal with a string of green falling away from the tip, which is a silhouette neither of the other two hand plates has. Eighth Leg fans four arms off a knuckle and Hauling Arms mirrors two of them inward; this is one. The green is the same venom token the acid finds wear, so the two poisons on the shelf read as one substance — this is the heavier dose, and the drawing says so by hanging a fat drop off the tip rather than by inventing a colour for it. `ss.lib.spider-arm`'s `venomed` variant does the staining and leaves the bones alone: a limb recoloured end to end stops reading as a limb.

glyph.description: Plate off, object only — the silhouette a collection shows for an entry not yet met.
